# RhythmPal — llms.txt
# Agent-readable product brief for AI crawlers, LLMs, and agent-based discovery
# Last updated: 2026-08-10

## Product
Name: RhythmPal
URL: https://rhythmpal.com
Category: AI SaaS / Health Technology
Description: Health intelligence platform that connects wearables, food logging, sleep, and habits — then finds the patterns you'd never see yourself. Powered by AI, built for people who want to understand their body, not just track it.

## Who It's For
Primary users: Health-conscious individuals, biohackers, athletes, and anyone using wearable devices who want actionable insights — not just raw data.
Use cases: Wearable data aggregation (Oura, Apple Watch, Garmin, Samsung, Fitbit), food photo logging with AI macro analysis, sleep pattern analysis, habit tracking, personalized health insights, daily PAL score.

## Pricing
- Free: Core tracking, basic insights
- Premium: Advanced pattern detection, unlimited history, priority AI analysis
- No credit card required to start

## Key Features
- PAL Score: Daily composite health score (sleep + activity + nutrition + HRV)
- Photo Food Logging: Snap a photo → instant macro breakdown via AI vision
- Wearable Integration: Oura Ring, Apple Health, Health Connect (Android), Garmin, Samsung, Fitbit
- AI Health Chat: Ask questions about your own health data
- Pattern Detection: Cross-signal insights (e.g., "your HRV drops when you eat late")
- Sleep Analysis: Stages, HRV, recovery scoring
- Activity Tracking: Steps, active calories, HR zones
- Proactive Insights: AI surfaces patterns before you ask

## Integration
RhythmPal integrates with wearables via:
- Android: Health Connect (Google)
- iOS: Apple Health via webhook (Health Auto Export app)
- Direct API: Oura Ring OAuth
